name: PostgreSQL
description: PostgreSQL 9.6 and later, and compatible services (Aurora, AlloyDB, Cloud SQL, Azure Flexible Server, Neon, Supabase). Reads pg_catalog directly rather than information_schema, which is slow on large catalogs and hides objects the user does not own. Takes no relation locks: sizes come from relpages, not pg_total_relation_size.

properties.label: Databases to read
properties.help: Empty: only the database above. *: every database you may connect to. Or a list; wildcards allowed.

options.label: Include partitions
options.help: Partition children are skipped by default; their parents are kept.

init: set session characteristics as transaction read only

version.sql: select version() as banner, current_setting('server_version') as version

test.sql: select current_user as login, current_database() as database, (select count(*) from pg_namespace where nspname not like 'pg\_%' and nspname <> 'information_schema') as schemas

source.sql: select 'PostgreSQL' as product, current_setting('server_version') as version, version() as banner, current_user as login

sql: select d.datname as name, shobj_description(d.oid, 'pg_database') as comment,
pg_get_userbyid(d.datdba) as owner, pg_database_size(d.oid) as size_bytes
from pg_database d
where not d.datistemplate and d.datallowconn and has_database_privilege(d.datname, 'CONNECT')
order by d.datname
select n.nspname as name, obj_description(n.oid, 'pg_namespace') as comment, pg_get_userbyid(n.nspowner) as owner
from pg_namespace n
order by n.nspname
select c.relname as name,
case c.relkind when 'r' then 'table' when 'v' then 'view' when 'm' then 'materialized_view'
when 'p' then 'partitioned_table' when 'f' then 'foreign_table' else 'other' end as type,
obj_description(c.oid, 'pg_class') as comment,
pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) as owner,
case when c.reltuples > 0 then c.reltuples::bigint
when coalesce(s.n_live_tup, 0) > 0 then s.n_live_tup
when c.reltuples = 0 then 0 end as row_count,
case when c.relkind in ('r', 'm') then
(c.relpages::bigint + coalesce(tc.relpages, 0)::bigint) * current_setting('block_size')::bigint end as size_bytes,
case when c.relkind in ('v', 'm') then pg_get_viewdef(c.oid, true) end as definition,
c.relispartition as is_partition,
case when c.relispartition then
(select pn.nspname || '.' || pc.relname from pg_inherits i
join pg_class pc on pc.oid = i.inhparent
join pg_namespace pn on pn.oid = pc.relnamespace
where i.inhrelid = c.oid limit 1) end as partition_of
from pg_class c
join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
left join pg_class tc on tc.oid = c.reltoastrelid
left join pg_stat_all_tables s on s.relid = c.oid
where n.nspname = {{schema}} and c.relkind in ('r', 'v', 'm', 'f', 'p')
and ({{options.includePartitions}} or not c.relispartition)
[[and c.relname > {{after}}]]
order by c.relname collate "C"
limit {{limit|int}}
select c.relname as dataset, a.attnum as ordinal, a.attname as name,
format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) as data_type, not a.attnotnull as nullable,
pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid) as default_value, col_description(c.oid, a.attnum) as comment,
a.attidentity <> '' or a.attgenerated <> ''
or coalesce(pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid), '') like 'nextval(%' as is_generated
from pg_attribute a
join pg_class c on c.oid = a.attrelid
join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
left join pg_attrdef d on d.adrelid = a.attrelid and d.adnum = a.attnum
where n.nspname = {{schema}} and c.relname in ({{datasets}}) and a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped
order by c.relname, a.attnum
select c.relname as dataset, con.conname as name, con.contype as type,
array(select a.attname from unnest(con.conkey) with ordinality k(num, ord)
join pg_attribute a on a.attrelid = con.conrelid and a.attnum = k.num order by k.ord) as columns,
case when con.contype = 'f' then current_database() end as ref_database,
fn.nspname as ref_schema, fc.relname as ref_dataset,
array(select a.attname from unnest(con.confkey) with ordinality k(num, ord)
join pg_attribute a on a.attrelid = con.confrelid and a.attnum = k.num order by k.ord) as ref_columns,
pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid) as definition
from pg_constraint con
join pg_class c on c.oid = con.conrelid
join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
left join pg_class fc on fc.oid = con.confrelid
left join pg_namespace fn on fn.oid = fc.relnamespace
where n.nspname = {{schema}} and c.relname in ({{datasets}}) and con.contype in ('p', 'u', 'f', 'c')
and (con.conparentid = 0 or con.contype <> 'f')
order by c.relname, con.conname
select t.relname as dataset, i.relname as name, ix.indisunique as is_unique, ix.indisprimary as is_primary,
am.amname as method,
array(select a.attname from unnest(ix.indkey) with ordinality k(num, ord)
join pg_attribute a on a.attrelid = ix.indrelid and a.attnum = k.num order by k.ord) as columns,
pg_get_indexdef(ix.indexrelid) as definition
from pg_index ix
join pg_class t on t.oid = ix.indrelid
join pg_class i on i.oid = ix.indexrelid
join pg_namespace n on n.oid = t.relnamespace
join pg_am am on am.oid = i.relam
where n.nspname = {{schema}} and t.relname in ({{datasets}})
order by t.relname, i.relname
select p.proname as name,
case p.prokind when 'f' then 'function' when 'p' then 'procedure' when 'a' then 'aggregate' when 'w' then 'window' end as type,
l.lanname as language, pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid) as arguments,
pg_get_function_result(p.oid) as returns, obj_description(p.oid, 'pg_proc') as comment,
pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) as owner
from pg_proc p
join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace
join pg_language l on l.oid = p.prolang
where n.nspname = {{schema}}
order by p.proname, p.oid
select distinct v.relname as dataset, current_database() as upstream_database, tn.nspname as upstream_schema,
t.relname as upstream_dataset, 'view_dependency' as kind
from pg_depend d
join pg_rewrite r on r.oid = d.objid
join pg_class v on v.oid = r.ev_class
join pg_namespace vn on vn.oid = v.relnamespace
join pg_class t on t.oid = d.refobjid
join pg_namespace tn on tn.oid = t.relnamespace
where d.classid = 'pg_rewrite'::regclass and d.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass
and d.deptype = 'n' and v.oid <> t.oid and v.relkind in ('v', 'm')
and t.relkind in ('r', 'v', 'm', 'f', 'p') and vn.nspname = {{schema}}
order by 1, 3, 4
select r.rolname as name, case when r.rolcanlogin then 'user' else 'role' end as type,
r.rolcanlogin as can_login, r.rolsuper as superuser,
array(select b.rolname from pg_auth_members m join pg_roles b on b.oid = m.roleid
where m.member = r.oid order by 1) as member_of,
shobj_description(r.oid, 'pg_authid') as comment
from pg_roles r
where r.rolname !~ '^pg_'
order by r.rolname
select c.relname as dataset, coalesce(g.rolname, 'PUBLIC') as principal, a.privilege_type as privilege,
case c.relkind when 'v' then 'view' when 'm' then 'materialized_view' else 'table' end as object_type,
gr.rolname as grantor, a.is_grantable as grantable
from pg_class c
join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
cross join lateral aclexplode(c.relacl) a
left join pg_roles g on g.oid = a.grantee
left join pg_roles gr on gr.oid = a.grantor
where n.nspname = {{schema}} and c.relkind in ('r', 'v', 'm', 'f', 'p') and c.relacl is not null
order by 1, 2, 3
select pol.polname as name, 'row_access' as type, c.relname as dataset,
pg_get_expr(pol.polqual, pol.polrelid) as definition, c.relrowsecurity as enabled,
array(select rolname from pg_roles where oid = any(pol.polroles) order by 1) as applies_to,
case pol.polcmd when 'r' then 'SELECT' when 'a' then 'INSERT' when 'w' then 'UPDATE'
when 'd' then 'DELETE' else 'ALL' end as command
from pg_policy pol
join pg_class c on c.oid = pol.polrelid
join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
where n.nspname = {{schema}}
order by c.relname, pol.polname
select s.tablename as dataset, s.attname as field, s.null_frac as null_fraction,
s.n_distinct as distinct_count, s.avg_width as avg_width
from pg_stats s
where s.schemaname = {{schema}} and s.tablename in ({{datasets}})
order by s.tablename, s.attname

overlays.description: attgenerated arrived in PostgreSQL 12, and before 12 the name type takes no COLLATE clause (it always compares bytewise, which is the order keyset paging needs).

select c.relname as dataset, a.attnum as ordinal, a.attname as name,
format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) as data_type, not a.attnotnull as nullable,

order by c.relname, a.attnum

sql: select c.relname as dataset, con.conname as name, con.contype as type,
array(select a.attname from unnest(con.conkey) with ordinality k(num, ord)
join pg_attribute a on a.attrelid = con.conrelid and a.attnum = k.num order by k.ord) as columns,
case when con.contype = 'f' then current_database() end as ref_database,
fn.nspname as ref_schema, fc.relname as ref_dataset,
array(select a.attname from unnest(con.confkey) with ordinality k(num, ord)
join pg_attribute a on a.attrelid = con.confrelid and a.attnum = k.num order by k.ord) as ref_columns,
pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid) as definition
from pg_constraint con
join pg_class c on c.oid = con.conrelid
join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
left join pg_class fc on fc.oid = con.confrelid
left join pg_namespace fn on fn.oid = fc.relnamespace
where n.nspname = {{schema}} and c.relname in ({{datasets}}) and con.contype in ('p', 'u', 'f', 'c')
order by c.relname, con.conname
select p.proname as name,
case when p.proisagg then 'aggregate' when p.proiswindow then 'window' else 'function' end as type,
l.lanname as language, pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid) as arguments,
pg_get_function_result(p.oid) as returns, obj_description(p.oid, 'pg_proc') as comment,
pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) as owner
from pg_proc p
join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace
join pg_language l on l.oid = p.prolang
where n.nspname = {{schema}}
order by p.proname, p.oid
